prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 7 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM, Flashback, warm afternoon sunlight.
Image 1: the character sheet of Lu Shaoze (28), look S0
Image 2: the character sheet of Ji Hongyuan (56)
Image 3: the character sheet of Ji Ran (27), look S1
Image 4: the location INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 5: the location INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 7: the location INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 8: the location INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 9: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 10: the prop document envelope; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Ji Hongyuan sits on the long cream leather sofa in front of the French windows, facing the front display cabinets. The low marble-and-gilt coffee table stands in front of him on the beige patterned carpet, and the kraft document envelope lies on it. Lu Shaoze, at 23, stands on the carpet on the near side of the coffee table, facing the sofa with his head bowed. He wears the fitted navy-blue knit polo sweater, the charcoal-grey wool trousers and black derby shoes. The younger Ji Ran, at 22, stands half-hidden behind the white marble column, which is in front of the left wall near the archway. She wears the black knit mini dress, her long hair straight, and peers around the column. Camera side: in front of everyone, on the display-cabinet side, facing the sofa and the windows.
Panel 1: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the display cabinets facing the French windows. Leaves sway outside the sunlit French windows. Ji Hongyuan, on the cream sofa, sweeps the document envelope off the marble table with the back of his hand. It drops onto the carpet at the feet of Lu Shaoze, who keeps his head bowed. Ji Ran peers from behind the marble column by the archway.
Panel 2: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lu Shaoze on the display-cabinet side, eye level, facing the sofa. Ji Hongyuan leans back on the cream sofa with his arms spread and looks at Lu Shaoze with contempt. Lu Shaoze's shoulder and the back of his head fill the foreground.
Panel 3: Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off camera, low angle, from the coffee table side facing Lu Shaoze. Only Lu Shaoze, framed on the face and shoulders. He keeps his head down, swallows hard and clenches his jaw.
Panel 4: Close-up, fast push in, eye level, from the display-cabinet side facing the sofa. Ji Hongyuan's narrow eyes stay hard behind his gold-rimmed glasses.
Panel 5: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the display-cabinet side. Ji Hongyuan snorts and turns his face away toward the fireplace.
Panel 6: Medium shot, follow Lu Shaoze from the coffee table to the archway, eye level, from the display-cabinet side. Lu Shaoze stoops, picks up the envelope from the carpet and walks toward the archway by the left wall. He passes the marble column without noticing Ji Ran, who stays hidden behind it with her fists clenched.
Panel 7: Medium close-up, clean single, handheld, high angle, from the room's centre facing the left wall. Lu Shaoze is gone through the archway. Ji Ran slumps back against the left wall beside the column, a hand on her chest, gasping for breath with wet eyes.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
